claim: Build and validate the retained UE 5.8 Enhanced Input movement procedure under its recorded project assumptions.
boundary: This pack does not establish portability to another UE version, arbitrary pawn architecture, or arbitrary tutorial.

validation.structural: All expected assets, mappings, Blueprint nodes, pin connections, and compile state pass.
validation.behavioral: A retained input sequence produces forward/back/left/right movement.
validation.visual: Viewport evidence is reviewed for engine errors and intended response.
validation.human_gate: Required before presenting a generated game artifact as showcase quality.

recovery.resume_rule: Verify checkpoint hashes and UE 5.8 project identity before continuing.
